prompts.name: food
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration. Asset type: a single production sprite for a cozy 2D underground mouse colony game, used at 18-24 screen pixels and at 64px in teaching cards. Make ONE isolated item group on a genuinely transparent background. Style: clean pixel-inspired hand-painted game art, broad stepped shapes, sparse large highlight patches, restrained warm palette, dark warm contour, extremely clear silhouette, no tiny texture/noise, no realism. Side / slight three-quarter cutaway view, soft upper-left lighting, flat object with slight depth. Center the object, fill about 78% of the square canvas, comfortable transparent padding on every side. No ground, no tile, no scene, no frame, no text, no UI, no numbers, no symbols, no glow or cast shadow outside the object. It must read at tiny size; use 3-5 broad color values and purposeful shape breaks. Subject: A small pile of three ripe red-orange berries with a single distinct sage-green leaf and two pale wheat seeds. This icon means edible FOOD. Red round berries form the dominant silhouette; avoid flowers or loose confetti.
